propositions: In-flight code reviews are interrupted when auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container during active review, causing the incomplete review to cast a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks the existing backfill reconciler recovery mechanism.

The shutdown drain timeout (DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS = 45) is too short relative to maximum review duration (up to 911s observed), causing reviews to be killed mid-flight before they can complete or gracefully fail.

Transient git fetch timeouts (reproduced at 2/25 runs exceeding 300s) convert to vote-bearing BLOCK decisions, which the reconciler then treats as 'already voted' and never retries, creating an invisible-infinite-loop of orphaned changes.

Retryable error conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, process-teardown-mid-review) must cast no vote and remain eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive, whereas terminal conditions (finding, gate-disabled, indeterminate) must cast fail-closed -1.
After N consecutive retryable failures on the same revision, the vote must escalate to a fail-closed -1 with exhaustion note and emit a CloudWatch metric, preventing unbounded retry loops.
